blocks.text: **CVE-2026-106125 - Sneeit Framework WordPress plugin code injection (CVSS 9.8).** The Sneeit Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7 via the 'callback' parameter of the sneeit_compact_menu_mega_content AJAX action. The handler sneeit_compact_menu_mega_content_callback() is registered on the wp_ajax_nopriv_ hook and passes the attacker-supplied 'callback' value directly into call_user_func() after only a function_exists() check,… Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 1.2% probability / 69th percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. No public exploit or proof-of-concept identified in tracked sources. Mitigation: Apply the vendor fix or mitigation; remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.
